title: Red Murphy and the Whispering Sands
moral: True strength comes from courage, humility, and helping others when they need it.

story: Red Murphy rides across the Wild West with his horse Whiskey, carrying an urgent letter for the sheriff of Silver Gulch. Early in his journey, he encounters bandits but cleverly avoids trouble using his quick thinking. As he travels into the whispering sands, he faces a dangerous patch of quicksand that nearly traps his horse, but he remains calm and pulls Whiskey to safety with a rope. Continuing on, Red finds a stranded boy named Billy who has lost his mule and is exhausted. Red helps him, showing kindness and humility as they travel together. Near Silver Gulch, the bandits return and confront him again, but instead of fighting, Red uses calm reasoning and courage to avoid violence. Finally, he delivers the letter safely to the sheriff, ensuring the town is warned of danger. As he rides home, Red reflects on his journey, realizing that true strength comes not just from bravery, but from humility, wisdom, and helping others.
